module: Tree of domains, branches and skills of career mode. It reads all info.json files under /gameplay/domains/ (recursively) and infers from the folder structure (domains / branches / skills) the pathId (folder names joined by "-", e.g. "apm-motorsport"), the parent and the type (isDomain, isBranch, isSkill). It computes levels and XP from the value of the player's attribute (career_modules_playerAttributes), the reward multipliers per level, the unlock conditions (flags) and saves the "unlocked" state in career/branchUnlocks.json.
notes: A branch level is defined by levels[i].requiredValue; calcBranchLevelFromValue returns -1 if no threshold is reached. A "missing" branch (id = "missing") is returned when the identifier is unknown.
Old attribute names (timeTrials, drift, delivery, police…) are translated to the new paths via oldAttributeNamesToNewNames, with a warning in the log.
A branch with isInDevelopment is locked (unlockCondition type "never"). unlockCondition types handled in checkUnlocks: unlockFlag, anyNunlockFlags (at least n flags among a list) and never.
Display order: domains sorted by order, then their children recursively; order[attributeKey] (money = 0, beamXP = 1, vouchers = 9999) is used to sort the attributes.
The "max" level is the last level whose isInDevelopment is false (levels[i].isMaxLevel).
Bug: M.onPlayerAttributesChanged = onPlayerAttributesChanged exports an undefined variable (nil).
Bug: onCareerActive rereads branchUnlocks.json but the inner loop that should reapply the fields is empty; the saved "unlocked" values are therefore not restored here (checkUnlocks recomputes them).

Potential bug: getLevelRewardMultiplier indexes branch.levels[level] without a check; if the level is -1 (no threshold reached), the index is nil and the field access fails. getBranchSimpleInfo can also divide by neededForNext = -1 at the last level.
moduleVersion = 42: an older save (info.json version < 42) is considered outdated.

oldAttributeNamesToNewNames.desc: Old attribute names to current paths (e.g. drift to bmra-drift).

newAttributeNamesToOldNames.desc: Inverse table. Built from the old table; if several old names target the same path, the last one walked wins.

onPlayerAttributesChanged.desc: Always nil: reference to a variable not defined in the file.

getOrder.desc: Returns the order of an attribute key (order table) or -math.huge if unknown.

getBranches.desc: Returns all branches keyed by id. On the first call, loads the info.json files of /gameplay/domains/, sorts them (domains then children) and propagates the parent's color.

getBranchByPath.desc: Looks up a branch by pathId; accepts the old names (warning logged).

getBranchByDomainBranchSkill.desc: Builds the pathId "domain-branch-skill" (absent parts are omitted) and returns the branch.

skillId.desc: Skill (used only if branchId is given).

getSortedBranches.desc: Returns the list of branches sorted by order (cached).

calcBranchLevelFromValue.desc: Computes a branch's level for an XP value: last level whose requiredValue <= val, plus the progress toward the next one.

returns.desc: Progress within the current level (-1 if there is no next).
XP needed to reach the next level (-1 if there is no next).
Threshold of the current level (-1 if there is no next).
Threshold of the next level (-1 if there is no next).

getBranchSimpleInfo.desc: Returns a summary for the UI: label, level, icon, curLvlProgress, neededForNext, processPercent and max (number of levels).

getBranchLevel.desc: The player's current level in a branch (based on their attribute). Returns nil if the branch is unknown; also returns the values of calcBranchLevelFromValue.

getBranchLevelByPath.desc: Same as getBranchLevel, taking a pathId.

getBranchXP.desc: The player's attribute value (XP) for the branch, -1 if it is unknown to the attribute system, nil if the branch is "missing".

getXPNeededForLevel.desc: XP required (requiredValue) to reach a level, -1 if the level does not exist.

getLevelLabel.desc: Label of a level: "ui.career.lvlLabelMax" for the last one, the level's levelName otherwise, or a text with context {lvl}.

getLevelRewardMultiplier.desc: Reward multiplier of the player's current level (levels[level].rewardMultiplier). The default multipliers go from 1 to 5 in steps of 0.25 when the branch declares defaultRewardMultipliers.

orderAttributeKeysByBranchOrder.desc: Sorts a list of attribute keys in place according to the branch order and returns it.

orderBranchNamesKeysByBranchOrder.desc: Sorts a list of branch identifiers (all by default) according to the branch order.

expandUnlocks.desc: Replaces in a level's unlock list each "automaticMission" entry with an "unlockCard" card giving the number of challenges available for this branch; the other entries are kept.

checkUnlocks.desc: Recomputes unlocked, unlockInfo, lockedReason and unlockInfos of each branch according to unlockCondition and career_modules_unlockFlags.

extractBranchPathIdFromFilePath.desc: Infers the pathId from a file path located under /gameplay/domains/.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Profile save hook: writes <save>/career/branchUnlocks.json with the unlocked field of each branch (career_saveSystem.jsonWriteFileSafe).

onCareerActive.desc: Hook called on career activation/deactivation; on activation reads branchUnlocks.json (see notes: the restoration is empty).

onGetUnlockFlagDefinitions.desc: Hook where each branch declares unlock flags: "<id>-level-<n>" for each level (and unlockFlags of the level) and one flag per certification (set when the required mission is passed).

flagDefinitions.desc: Table to fill with the flag definitions.
